from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
import io,json,sys
import ai_sdlc_workbench
from ai_sdlc_workbench.workspace import initialize_workspace
from ai_sdlc_workbench.cli import main
base=Path(sys.argv[1]); source=Path(sys.argv[2]); library=Path(sys.argv[3])
assert Path(ai_sdlc_workbench.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(library.resolve()),ai_sdlc_workbench.__file__
workspace=initialize_workspace(base/'workspace')
assert not (workspace/'adapters/browser').exists()
for adapter in ['claude-code','copilot','mcp','sources']:
    assert (workspace/'adapters'/adapter/'README.md').is_file()
for name in ['.agents/skills/analyze-requirement/SKILL.md','.agents/skills/verify-implementation/references/browser-investigation.md','knowledge/templates/sdlc/defect-report.md']:
    assert (workspace/name).read_bytes()==(source/name).read_bytes(),name
assert not list((workspace/'core').rglob('*.py'))
output=io.StringIO()
with redirect_stdout(output):
    exit_code=main(['--workspace',str(workspace),'validate'])
assert exit_code==0,output.getvalue()
print(json.dumps({'workspace':str(workspace),'runtime':ai_sdlc_workbench.__file__,'validation':json.loads(output.getvalue()),'adapter_runtime_present':False,'updated_guides_match_source':True},indent=2))
